questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.learningObjective: Identify the correct log rule application
questions.stem: An amateur astronomer logs a star whose brightness is 8 and finds log base 2 of 8 equals 3, confirming the rule.

options.text: The log equals the exponent making base power the value
The log value is the base raised to the brightness
The log rule gives the exponent needed to reach the value
options.misconception: treats log as multiplication by base

options.text: The log is the value divided by the base

questions.explanation: Log base b of x is the exponent y such that b^y=x. The tempting division idea fails because exponents are not quotients.
questions.hint: Ask what power of the base gives the value.
